'''2007 Worlds Team Michael Gemme LS We'll Handle This''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Michael Gemme]] at [[2007 World Championship]] (Team).

Sheet shows many Imperial Atrocity (V); published 5× (V) + 1 non-V per OCR.


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Michael Gemme]]
* '''Event:''' [[2007 World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS13]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[We'll Handle This / Duel Of The Fates|We'll Handle This]]
* '''Stage:''' Team
